sections.heading: Live interactions for creators
sections.text: HyperChat brings messages, text-to-speech, recorded voices, sounds and media into a creator’s existing stream. Creators choose which interactions appear through their moderation settings.
sections.label: Explore interaction features

sections.heading: Built for your stream
sections.text: Explore local previews of audience interactions, the moderation queue and the journey from a viewer’s message to an OBS alert. Preview actions do not affect a real broadcast.
sections.label: Creator fees, profiles and onboarding

sections.heading: The people behind HyperChat
sections.text: HyperChat is a product of Streamheart Private Limited, a DPIIT-recognised startup. Our partners include ClipWave and Soraivy, with support from ElevenLabs Grants.

/features.heading: More ways to join the moment.

sections.heading: Messages, text-to-speech and recorded voice
sections.text: Text-to-speech reads a viewer’s typed message using a generated voice. A voice message plays the viewer’s own recorded audio. This website offers local previews; it does not record or submit voice messages.

sections.heading: Soundboard, images and GIFs
sections.text: Explore sound and media previews alongside text and voice. Interaction types depend on what a creator enables.

sections.heading: OBS alerts and creator controls
sections.text: Follow the interaction journey from viewer to HyperChat, OBS and the live stream. Try the local moderation preview to review, approve or hide example interactions.
sections.label: Get help with OBS, audio and moderation

sections.heading: Creator fees and payouts
sections.text: HyperChat’s platform fee is 11%. Payouts are monthly, and international payments are accepted. Eligibility and settlement conditions are covered in the Creator Terms.
sections.label: Read the Creator Terms

sections.heading: Meet the creators
sections.text: Explore our creator directory, including brand ambassadors captain_vaani, Chiaa and Latifa. JavaScript enables creator search and shareable profile selections.

sections.heading: Prepare for onboarding
sections.text: V2 verification and activation are still being completed. For onboarding questions, contact ankit@hyperchat.space. HyperChat adds interactions to an existing broadcast through OBS browser sources.
sections.label: Find setup help

sections.heading: Streamheart Private Limited
sections.text: HyperChat is a product of Streamheart Private Limited. We help live creators bring their audiences into the conversation. Streamheart Private Limited is recognised under the Startup India initiative.

sections.heading: Partners and support
sections.text: ClipWave helps creators generate stream clips. Soraivy is a creator-first video platform built in India, designed to help small and emerging creators grow faster and earn more. HyperChat is supported by ElevenLabs Grants.

sections.heading: Get in touch
sections.text: For creator, company or partnership enquiries, contact ankit@hyperchat.space.
sections.label: Contact and support

sections.heading: OBS alerts and audio
sections.text: Check that your browser source is visible in the active OBS scene. For audio, check the mixer, volume and monitoring device. A short local recording helps verify what your audience will hear.

sections.heading: Voice previews and moderation
sections.text: The website’s speech preview uses a local voice provided by your browser or device. An interaction may wait for moderation or earlier items in the queue. Sending an interaction does not guarantee immediate on-stream appearance.
sections.label: Explore the local previews

sections.heading: Contact the team
sections.text: Email ankit@hyperchat.space for help. For payment and delivery questions, consult the viewer terms and refund policy.
sections.label: Read the refund and cancellation policy
